episodes.name: Burnin' Down the House
episodes.overview: While Carlton is away at a Young Republican camp, Will cooks up a flambe of a disaster on a night when an influential judge is coming to dinner, and Will can only make it through the night with the help of Geoffrey, and other plan is not to make Phil find out.

episodes.name: Get a Job
episodes.overview: In competition with Carlton, Will sets out to prove he's the best man for the job on Hilary's TV show by escorting a famous comedian's sister out on the town.

episodes.name: Stress Related
episodes.overview: After learning a little something about initiative, Will jumps to Hilary's aid prior to a key business meeting at the station, meanwhile an unemployed Carlton subs for Philip on career day at Ashley's school.

episodes.name: Bourgie Sings the Blues
episodes.overview: The thrill is gone for "runaway yuppie" Carlton, who can't handle another disappointment, let alone his long-awaited Princeton interview.

episodes.name: The Script Formerly Known As...
episodes.overview: Will decides to book a juror dismissed from Philip's big show-biz madam sex-scandal case for Hilary's show, which results in embarrassment for Judge Banks and some annoying apologies from Will and Hilary.

episodes.name: Not, I Barbecue
episodes.overview: Will and Carlton's double date ends unromantically when a big bruiser shows up looking for his squeeze.

episodes.name: Not With My Cousin You Don't
episodes.overview: Freakin' out! On the home intercom, Will and Carlton overhear Ashley talking about sex.

episodes.name: Viva Lost Wages
episodes.overview: Carlton is on a roll in Vegas, celebrating his birthday at the gaming tables with Will in tow but suddenly the tables turn, and the duo enter a dance contest to recoup their losses.

episodes.name: There's the Rub (1)
episodes.overview: Hilary and Carlton volunteer at a homeless shelter on Thanksgiving, while the extended family fills up on holiday treats.

episodes.name: There's the Rub (2)
episodes.overview: Will and Philip are arrested at a massage parlor on Thanksgiving. Hilary and Carlton get a lesson in humility at the homeless shelter.

episodes.name: I, Ooh, Baby, Baby
episodes.overview: Hilary's show has its national premiere. What more could she possibly want? How about a baby?

episodes.name: Boxing Helena
episodes.overview: Will's pride is on the ropes when a gorgeous boxing instructor KOs him at the gym.

episodes.name: I, Clownius
episodes.overview: It's no laughing matter when a bomb-toting clown holds Philip hostage in the courtroom on the day of the showbiz madam's sentencing.

episodes.name: Breaking Up is Hard To Do (1)
episodes.overview: Ka-boooom! That explosion you hear is Philip and Vivian's marriage after Philip decides to go into politics.

episodes.name: Breaking Up is Hard To Do (2)
episodes.overview: Breaking up may not be so hard to do for an angry Vivian, but when Philip finds he's lost without her, Will and Carlton conspire to reunite them.

episodes.name: I, Bowl Buster
episodes.overview: After being accepted at Princeton, a worried Carlton changes his life plans and retreats to a place where everybody knows his name - the bowling alley.

episodes.name: The Butler's Son Did It
episodes.overview: Geoffrey's life changes overnight when a man claiming to be his long-lost son shows up and charms everyone - except Will, who discovers the guy's not what he seems. Meanwhile, Hilary starts writing her autobiography, and an early childhood photo reveals a shocking secret.

episodes.name: Hare Today...
episodes.overview: The church's widowed reverend is a man of esteemed reputation, but not in the eyes of Will - who spies him making a play for Aunt Vivian.

episodes.name: I, Whoops, There It Is
episodes.overview: Dick Clark has a cameo on this backstage outing that has Will Smith visiting with series stars and screening series bloopers.

episodes.name: I, Stank Horse
episodes.overview: Philip expects Ashley to decline an offer for what he considers a degrading role in an ad by a director who could also give her a recommendation to a top New York school.

episodes.name: I, Stank Hole in One
episodes.overview: On Live with Regis and Kathie Lee, Hilary subs for Gifford but doesn't see eye-to-eye with co-host Philbin. Meanwhile, Will subs for Carlton in a golf tourney and gets buddy-buddy with Philip, making Carlton jealous.

episodes.name: Eye, Tooth
episodes.overview: William Shatner stars as Hilary's talk-show guest, but Will must find a way to beam him from the dentist's chair to the set. Meanwhile, Hilary's show treks to New York and Ashley insists on tagging along.

episodes.name: I, Done (1)
episodes.overview: The mansion's for sale and everybody's in the fast lane... except Will, who's stuck on life's soft shoulder.

episodes.name: I, Done (2)
episodes.overview: The Banks move out. The Jeffersons are about to move in. And Will turns out the lights.
